dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Learning about me would cost you a fortune.

dialogues.speaker: Jayant
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I understand. Everyone has their own fate, none less precious than anybody else's.

dialogues.speaker: Jayant
dialogues.text: But if you really want to put a price on it, I just might be able to afford it.

dialogues.speaker: Jayant
dialogues.text: If my background were worse, I wouldn't be able to go on the streets and meet people from all walks of life.

dialogues.speaker: Jayant
dialogues.text: Anyway, you know where to find me. If you ever need a friend, I'm right here waiting.
